summary: Replace the broad default FedEx MCP executor and Cobra mirror with eight reviewed shipping tools.
reason: A generic endpoint selector and runtime command mirror cannot be constrained by a Hermes tool allowlist and exposed unrelated file, SQL, import/export, webhook, bulk, and tracking-daemon capabilities.
validated_outcome: Unit and MCP protocol tests assert the exact eight-tool surface, deeply matched complete runtime/manifest request schemas for all eight tools, official optional rate controls and grouped-package semantics, country-aware nonblank address minima with empty optional locality fields accepted where permitted, resolution controls, required shipment pickup/total-weight/payment/conditional-payor/label fields, shared nested pickup-availability validation of every modeled address field before HTTP, conditional YOUR_PACKAGING dimensions, FedEx's default-inch behavior for blank/null/omitted dimension units, and operation-specific read-only, destructive, idempotent, and open-world annotations; fedex_execute and broad CLI mirror tools are absent, non-FedEx remote API origins are rejected before credentials can be sent, shipment validity requires explicit alert evidence, pickup availability retains official per-option carrier/date/window evidence, and responses expose only action-specific allowlisted fields.
